Chief Complaint: Pain abdomen, vaginal bleeding

Patient had sudden severe abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks of gestation. An ultrasound scan showed a normal fetus with no signs of distress. The patient underwent an emergency cesarean section, and the baby was delivered in good condition.
Allergies: NKDA

Past Medical History: None

Discharge Diagnosis: Placenta previa, Abruptio placentae, Postpartum hemorrhage
